o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish آرالق (aralıq), from آرا (ara) + ـلق (-lıq). By surface analysis, ara + -lıq.
From daş- (“to overflow”) + -qın. See Bashkir ташҡын (taşqın) for cognates.
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish اورمك (üremek), from Proto-Turkic *üdre-. Compare Turkish üremek.
